The input is divided into rectangular panels by full-color separator rows and columns. In each panel, count cells of the non-background marker color. Produce a compact output grid with one output cell per panel, preserving panel layout:

```

1 3 1 3
1 3 3 3
```
Those `1`s correspond exactly to panels with two 2s; all remaining output cells are background `3`.
